rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the feeling of being romantically infatuated with someone you are not dating.

example.english: I used to have a crush on the girl in the class next door.
example.traditional: 我以前暗戀過隔離班嗰個女仔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 am3 lyun2 gwo3 gaak3 lei4 baan1 go2 go3 neoi5 zai2

rows.note: Use this when “crush” refers to the person you are secretly romantically interested in, rather than the feeling itself.

example.english: He was my crush in secondary school.
example.traditional: 佢係我中學嗰陣嘅暗戀對象。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zung1 hok6 go2 zan6 ge3 am3 lyun2 deoi3 zoeng6

rows.jyutping: jan4 bik1 jan4 ge3 coeng4 min2
rows.note: Use this for a situation where so many people are packed together that they are physically pressing against one another.

example.english: The lift was such a crush of people that I could barely move.
example.traditional: 部𨋢入面真係人逼人嘅場面，郁一步都難。
example.jyutping: bou6 lip1 jap6 min6 zan1 hai6 jan4 bik1 jan4 ge3 coeng4 min2 juk1 jat1 bou6 dou1 naan4
